  \caption{\textbf{Ancestor-propagated evaluation on the 13-genome and 21-genome reference panels.} The 13-genome panel holds 13 prokaryotes (11 bacteria and 2 archaea) and the 21-genome panel 21 bacteria. Truth and predictions are propagated over \texttt{is\_a} and \texttt{part\_of}, and the three GO roots are removed. Experimental-truth metrics (``exp.''; $323$ proteins on the 13-genome panel and $228$ on the 21-genome panel) are pooled over genomes; all-evidence metrics (``all'') are means of per-genome values. About $85\%$ of the all-evidence truth derives from electronic annotation, much of it assigned by InterPro, which favours InterProScan and every configuration with an InterProScan channel. EC $F_{\max}$ (21-genome panel only) uses exact four-digit matches against the Swiss-Prot EC numbers of the panel proteins and is pooled. On the 13-genome panel GSPA integrates DIAMOND, Pfam, and InterProScan claims with all Stage 1 priors and Stage 2A relaxation. No InterProScan output exists for the 21-genome panel and its Pfam claims hold about $15$ GO pairs per genome, so the GSPA row there is effectively DIAMOND-only. The ESM-2 $k$-NN row uses the 150M-parameter t30 model with the other genomes of a 30-genome panel as references. Methods without raw prediction output are listed as not evaluated. Source: \texttt{results/pillar1\_suite2\_panel13\_21\_sota.tsv} (pipeline P03).}
